A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the wanning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], '''this man''' was escorting the dangerous former Jedi [[Lycan]] back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when his ship crashed.

==Biography==
This individual was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Serving the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], this Jedi was dispatched to a distant prison world six months following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. His mission was to escort the former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] turned [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], [[Lycan]], back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to be tried by the High Council. When Lycan was safely stowed aboard his shuttle, the Jedi began his trek back to the Temple when the Dark Jedi attempted to seize control of the cockpit. During the confrontation, the Jedi Knight lost control and the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] plunged down the [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]] of a rural [[Planet/Legends|planet]], crashing on the property of [[Farm/Legends|farmer]] [[Darca Nyl]]. When Nyl rushed to investigate, the wounded Jedi crawled from the wreckage and handed the former [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] his [[Lightsaber/Legends|weapon]], warning him of the danger Lycan posed. His warning given, the Jedi [[Death/Legends|died]] amongst the burning wreckage of his ship. Wielding the Jedi's lightsaber, Nyl rushed back to his home to find his son, [[Neas Nyl|Neas]], murdered by the Dark Jedi. Enraged, Nyl began a journey of revenge, seeking justice for his slain son, and eventually killed Lycan on the planet [[Molavar/Legends|Molavar]].<ref name="Nomad" />
